name: battleboarding-entry
description: Battleboarding Business Entry: a Persona 5 styled, fully offline job and service tracker for an Indonesian battleboarding community. One vanilla-JS app shipped as a standalone HTML file, an Android APK (Capacitor), a Windows desktop app (Electron) and a GitHub Pages demo.
author: ammarfirman

scripts.electron: npm run sync:win && npx electron windows-app
scripts.apk: npm run build && npm run sync && cd android && gradlew assembleDebug
scripts.ipa: npm run build && npm run sync:ios && cd ios/App && xcodebuild -scheme App -configuration Release -archivePath build/App.xcarchive archive
